name: Tower Defense · Codex 15-minute test
objective: Build a polished, playable, dependency-free browser tower defense game for casual players, and exercise Epoptes with real Codex cycles.

done.check: Fresh automated checks cover placement, currency, waves, damage, upgrades, lives, victory/defeat and restart
Real browser smoke test passes without runtime errors, with a saved screenshot
README explains launching, controls and verification; final review records usability and visual quality

non_goals: Dependencies, frameworks, accounts, backend, multiplayer or publishing
Modifying Epoptes source or existing user changes
approval_required: Spending money or adding paid services
Publishing, uploads or external writes other than the already-authorized Codex provider
Deleting or overwriting user data outside the deliverable
Changing the done definition, model or time box
